claim.claim-text: 1. A capsule (26) for an electronic vapour inhaler (10), the capsule comprising:

a shell (28) containing a flavour-release medium (40); and an induction heatable element (42) contained within the shell (28) and arranged to heat the flavour-release medium (40); wherein the shell (28) includes a base region (30) and a sidewall region (32), and wherein the base region (30) is formed of an air permeable material.
2. A capsule according to claim 1, wherein the flavour-release medium (40) is tobacco or tobacco material.
3. A capsule according to claim 2, wherein the tobacco or tobacco material is impregnated with a vapour-forming medium.
4. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the flavour-release medium (40) is in the form of fine pieces or pellets or has a fibrous form.
5. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the base region (30) and the sidewall region (32) are integrally formed.
6. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the shell (28) further includes a lid (38).
7. A capsule according to claim 6, wherein the lid is formed of an air permeable material.
8. A capsule according to claim 6 or 7, wherein the lid (38) is sealed to an upper periphery (33) of the sidewall region (32).
9. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the cross-section of the induction heatable element (42) conforms generally to the cross-section of the shell (28).
10. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the size of the induction heatable element (42) is less than the size of the shell (28).
11. A capsule according to any preceding claim, wherein the shell (28) has a generally cylindrical shape.
13. An electronic vapour inhaler according to claim 12, wherein the induction heating arrangement comprises an induction coil.

14. An electronic vapour inhaler according to claim 12 or 13, wherein the housing (12) includes a chamber (24) in which the capsule (26) is removably disposed and an air inlet (54) through which ambient air can flow into the chamber (24) and into the shell (28) through the air permeable material.

15. An electronic vapour inhaler according to any one of claims 12 to 14, further including a temperature sensor (44, 62) for measuring the temperature inside the shell (28), wherein a control arrangement (20) of the electronic vapour inhaler is adapted to energise the induction heating arrangement (50) to maintain a substantially predetermined temperature inside the shell (28) based on the temperature measured by the temperature sensor (44, 62).
